notes.title: Sanguine Demo Hotfix
notes.notes: [h2]Sanguine Demo – Hotfix 1.1.0a[/h2][p]This hotfix directly addresses issues reported in the recent 1.1.0 release, along with a few additional fixes discovered after launch.[/p][h3]🔧 Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Ranking Screen[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]SS Rank[/b] would not display correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ranking screen not properly displaying when playing in [b]Modern Mode[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new stat: [b]Total Enemies Killed[/b] now displays at the end of the game.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Modern Mode[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where entering the [b]Diner area[/b] would briefly invert character controls.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Inventory & Equipment[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the [b]Shotgun, Glock 19, and Kitchen Knife[/b] would not correctly remove from Kris when transferring to/from the storage container.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Achievements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated the image for [b]Achievement 5[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue preventing [b]Achievement 7[/b] from triggering properly.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Sanguine Demo 0.9.91 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970004/c3e4555c9f7e14768c1fc50b42c44646ab99a7b4.png[/img]
This patch is contains fixes and minor updates for the demo!
[b]*It is highly recommended to create a new save*[/b]

The updates; fixing, adding and improving various things:
[list]
[*] Updated the project to unity 2022.3.22f
[*] Player aiming improvements
[*] Improved penetration hits
[*] Removed audio compression for music and adjusted levels - Hopefully this fixes some music audio issues I've been noticing for some folks
[*] Removed settings 'quality' toggle - Leaving this at max settings by default as at the moment it only changes the lighting
[*] Updated some text on a few documents
[*] Added shotgun shell discharge effect
[*] Added new shotgun audio
[*] Added new gun empty audio
[*] Added additional handgun ammo spawn
[*] Added additional bandage & sturdy bandage spawn
[*] Adjusted a few enemy locations & spawn triggers
[*] Adjusted gas station landed location camera
[*] Adjusted icon for cross scene door (the fog door)
[*] Fixed issue where pistol would lock up on reload
[*] Fixed issue where gas station map would not load properly
[*] Hopefully fixed an issue where you could get stuck in the gas station area
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.99.9
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970004/bb4ad8a653088cb24585bff9690b7014035e3144.png[/img]
View our Kickstarter here! -> https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/429101208/sanguine-a-classic-survival-horror-game?ref=project_build

[b]*Note: Old save files will likely not work with this patch, it is recommended to start a new game*[/b]

This patch is a chunky update for Kickstarter! Fixing & adding and improving various things:
-New main menu music
-New main menu effects
-Reduced build size by 100mb(ish)
-Updated & improved Kris animations
-Fixed turn 180 animation not properly working
-New gravity/world collision
-Fixed various texture issues
-Fixed various model truncations
-Added character model per status in the inventory
-Updated some documents
-Unified POI's for what Kris is saying vs what the world is saying
-Adjusted aim down with guns
-Balanced enemies
-Updated collision points for enemy weak points
-Updated all weapon damages
-Updated enemy health and speeds
-Added a few new enemy animations
-Updated several cutscene animations / timing
-Updated several camera positions and triggers
-Fully changed inside diner camera and lighting
-Updated controller layout to be pure classic tank & graphics
-Fixed various on-load bugs/issues
-Updated and added several new models throughout
-Added a few new events and POI's
-Optimized FPS and load times
-Fixed bug when dropping equipped item
-Added new weapon animations

notes.title: Patch 0.99.7
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970004/79facc60e109efd41df6ef6a72a6ecd169b3bcaa.png[/img]
This patch is a general update which adds new things, improving old ones, balances weapons and enemies & fixing some bugs.


New Models & Animations:
-Added a new Model for Kris
-Added a new texture for Kris, she now also blinks
-Added all new animations for all things Kris - movement, combat, ect

Balance:
-Adjusted damage of the Kitchen Knife, Glock19 & Shotgun
-Reduced swipe speed of the Kitchen knife by half
-Reduced shotgun piercing from 4 > 2
-Removed the laser attachment upgrade for the Glock 19
-Added the extended mag upgrade for the Glock19
-Adjusted locations of all framed paintings puzzle to be located inside the Diner
-Adjusted all music volumes
-Adjusted all surface SFX volumes

Fixes:
-Fixed a collision error where the drop zone is
-Fixed an issue where the police corpse blood would not move
-Adjusted van trunk opening size
-Removed unused assets in the gas station
-Fixed VHS tape reward from not dropping sometimes
-Adjusted multiple item interaction animations
-Fixed an issue where enemies would no longer follow you if you break line of sight under a certain distance
-Fixed a camera angle not rendering the player properly next to the police truck in the gas station
